ideas.title: Investigation into Alex Pretti Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti by ICE agents in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: The DOJ's investigation into the shooting and potential civil rights violations.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Was the use of force by ICE agents justified?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves a federal investigation into a potentially controversial use of force by law enforcement agents.

ideas.title: $9B Minnesota Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged $9B welfare fraud in Minnesota and the management of public funds.
ideas.angle: The House committee's investigation into the alleged fraud and the role of Governor Walz and Attorney General Ellison.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the alleged fraud?
How did the state of Minnesota manage public funds?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves a significant alleged fraud and potential mismanagement of public funds.
